gaps.detail: The case expects the URL path /item/{id} with id 1..101. The test asserts it, but no keyframe shows the URL: the 'Landed on ...' caption set at line ~208 is absent from 04-highlight-product-page-of-item-65.png, 05 and 06-final, which show only the heading 'Sprint PRO Carbon Cycling Helmet'. Item 65 appears only in the keyframe file name.

The case expects URL path /item/5. No keyframe after the click shows /item/5: the 'Landed on' caption is missing from 05-highlight-blizzard-rider-snowboard.png and 06. Also, 02-highlight-surprise-me-with-b-r-ski-boarding.png has the 'Surprise me' link hidden under the sticky header (only 'Clear all filters' is visible), so the highlighted element is out of view.

The case expects the URL path /item/77, /item/80 or /item/87. The landing keyframes 04-highlight-nomad-2-person-tent-an-xe-product.png and 05 show the heading 'Nomad 2-Person Tent' (brand XE) but no caption or URL, so the id is never visible.

The case expects /item/{id} with id in the Navigation set. 05-highlight-compass-pro-a-320-professional-compass-a-navigatio.png shows the heading but no caption or URL. The 'Page 2: ...?page=2' caption is also missing from 02-highlight-the-last-two-navigation-products.png, although its pager shows page 2 active.

The frames show different products, but only iteration 1 visibly identifies its /item/22 path. Iterations 2–10 lack their path captions, and the final distinct-ID summary is absent. Preserve the measured paths and final ID summary in the captured evidence.
